name: Flynn
self_text: I’m a mid‑30s Japanese woman who loves Hollow Lantern, mostly in casual queues. I play support, chatting by text or voice. I’m free on Saturday mornings, Sunday mornings or Sunday afternoons. Outside gaming I craft woodwork, a hobby that lets me unwind and build things from scratch.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into ranked matches. I'd strongly prefer that you play a damage role or you be flexible about your role (a damage role or a flexible role (I can fill any position)) though it's not a requirement. Nice if you're into Hollow Lantern. A big plus if you're available Saturday morning or Sunday afternoon or Sunday morning, though it's not a requirement.

I need you to be into ranked matches; only if we both play in ranked will we stay.
